تأرجحت (form IIq)
# تَأَرْجَحْتُ (taʔarjaḥtu) /ta.ʔar.d͡ʒaħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
# تَأَرْجَحْتَ (taʔarjaḥta) /ta.ʔar.d͡ʒaħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
# تَأَرْجَحْتِ (taʔarjaḥti) /ta.ʔar.d͡ʒaħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَأَرْجَحَ (taʔarjaḥa)
# تَأَرْجَحَتْ (taʔarjaḥat) /ta.ʔar.d͡ʒa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
